messages.label: Submit task
messages.note: Validate the request and store the task before starting asynchronous delivery.

messages.label: Accepted
messages.note: Confirm acceptance without waiting for completion; delivery can occur independently.

messages.label: Deliver task
messages.note: Wait for an available worker before delivering queued work to the task runner.

messages.label: Submit result
messages.note: After execution, validate the open task and store the result and pending notification.

messages.label: Result accepted
messages.note: Acknowledge the stored result; this does not imply that the sender has read it.

messages.label: Deliver result
messages.note: Notify the sender when available; otherwise keep the result queued for later delivery.

cards.title: Request
items: The service accepts a request before a worker completes it.
Vertical order describes logical steps rather than elapsed time.

cards.title: Delivery
items: Accepted work can remain queued until the worker becomes available.
Delivery failure does not imply that the request was never stored.

cards.title: Result
items: Results are stored before the sender receives a notification.
A successful response does not imply that the sender has read it.
